source.commentary: Lord of 7th in auspicious dignity or kendra/trikona indicates strong marriage promise.

interpretation: When the 7th lord is placed in a Kendra, Trikona, or 2nd/11th house, marriage promise is strong and traditionally occurs at a suitable time (interpretive indication, not a guarantee).

source.commentary: Venus in dignity with benefic association indicates marital happiness when other factors agree.

interpretation: Venus in strength or dignity blesses the native with timely marriage and harmonious union.

source.commentary: Benefic planets (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) aspecting or occupying the 7th house.

interpretation: Jupiter's auspicious aspect on the 7th house removes obstacles and solidifies the promise of marriage.

source.commentary: Navamsa 7th lord well-placed confirms D1 marriage promise.

interpretation: The lord of the 7th house in the Navamsa chart placed in dignity confirms strong marital destiny.
